name: circuit-board
useCase: Identify circuit-board hardware or an electronics configuration section.
misuse: Do not use the board as a connection or device-health status without a clear label.

16.reason: Three solid circular pads and two joined traces keep the circuit layout distinct, with at least 1px to the board frame.

24.reason: Three larger circular pads join a right-angle trace and a straight trace, with at least 1.5px of clear space to the board frame.
